summary: Evaluates a cubic Hermite/Bezier interpolation for a 3-component vector. With parameter t=a6, computes the four standard Hermite basis coefficients (2t^3-3t^2+1, t^3-2t^2+t, -2t^3+3t^2, t^3-t^2), then blends the three components of four input vectors (a2, a3, a4, a5) into the output vector a1 (X at this+0x0, Y at this+0x4, Z at this+0x8) and returns a1. No branches, no calls, no globals touched in the raw source.

local_names.v9: coefficient h11 = t^3 - t^2, weight of the fourth input vector
local_names.v10: coefficient h00 = 2t^3 - 3t^2 + 1, weight of the first input vector
local_names.v11: coefficient h10 = t^3 - 2t^2 + t, weight of the second input vector
local_names.v12: coefficient h01 = -2t^3 + 3t^2, weight of the third input vector
local_names.result: output vector base pointer a1, returned to the caller

operations.description: v6 = a6 * a6; v8 = a6 * v6; square and cube the interpolation parameter t
compute the four cubic Hermite basis coefficients: v10 = 2t^3 - 3t^2 + 1, v11 = t^3 - 2t^2 + t, v12 = -2t^3 + 3t^2, v9 = t^3 - t^2
this+0x0 = v10*a2[0] + v11*a3[0] + v12*a4[0] + v9*a5[0]; write the blended X component of the output vector
this+0x4 = v9*a5[1] + v12*a4[1] + v11*a3[1] + v10*a2[1]; write the blended Y component of the output vector
this+0x8 = v9*a5[2] + v12*a4[2] + v11*a3[2] + v10*a2[2]; write the blended Z component of the output vector
return a1; yield the output vector base pointer
